arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Santos argued non-citizens can seek relief for family hardship.
Ms. Sinzdak argued statutory text bars review of discretionary relief.
Chief Justice Roberts noted the statutory standard requires comparative analysis.
Justice Alito distinguished this case from prior due diligence rulings.

paragraphs: This case tests whether federal courts can review agency decisions on exceptional hardship. the sides that brought the case argue courts must apply legal standards. The government claims statutory bars block this review.
